sentences.text: Rajkumar vs State Of Rajasthan on 20 January, 2023
Author: Kuldeep Mathur Bench: Kuldeep Mathur

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Appeal No. 1516/2022 Rajkumar S/o Balu Ram, Aged About 45 Years, B/c Jat (Balara),
R/o Moulasar Tehsil Moulasar, District Nagaur.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
(At Present Lodged In Sub Jail, Merta)
 ----Appellant  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Pinki Meena W/o Nirmal Meena, R/o Bhato Ka Bass,
 Kuchaman City, Tehsil Kuchaman District Nagaur.
----Respondents For Appellant(s) : Mr. Rajendra Singh Chouhan
For Respondent(s) : Ms. Anita Gehlot, PP  Mr. Kuldeep Singh, for the  complainant  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 20/01/2023

The instant appeal has been filed under Section 14(A)(2) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act on behalf of the appellant, who is in custody in connection with FIR No.321/2022 registered at Police Station Kuchaman City, District Nagaur, for the offences under Sections 376D, 376(2)(n), 384, 506 of IPC and Section 3(1) (w), 3(2)(v) SC/ST Act.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant and Public Prosecutor for the State as also learned counsel appearing for the complainant.
Perused the material available on record.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that the the statements of the prosecutrix have been recorded before the competent criminal court on 17.01.2022, wherein she has been (2 of 2)
[CRLAS-1516/2022] declared hostile.
He further submits that the appellant is in judicial custody since long and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time to conclude.
Thus, learned counsel submits that benefit of bail may be extended to the appellant.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel appearing for the complainant vehemently opposed the bail application.

Having regard to the totality of facts and circumstances as available on record and upon consideration of the arguments advanced without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court deems it proper to enlarge the appellant on bail.
Consequently, the instant appeal is allowed.
The impugned order dated 14.09.2022 passed by the Special Judge, SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act Cases, Merta is set aside.

entities.text: Special Judge, SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act Cases, Merta
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is ordered that the accused-appellant Rajkumar S/o Balu Ram arrested in connection with aforesaid FIR, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided him furnish a personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- and two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned lower Court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 146-KshamaD/-
